newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to add more freighter flights to LatAm.
newsitem.headline: Air France to add more freighter flights to LatAm.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it planned to increase Boeing 747-200F frequencies on Latin American routes with the introduction of winter schedules, at the end of next month.

Air France is to add a third weekly frequency on its Paris-Mexico City B747F service and a second weekly frequency on its Paris-Buenos Aires freighter route,as a result of strong market demand, an Air France cargo official said.
The second Buenos Aires frequency will make a stopover at Sao Paulo with cargo capacity being split between the two cities, the official added.
The French state airline currently operates two weekly 747-200Fs flights between Paris and Sao Paulo.
